stil: Flat editorial illustration for a corporate training presentation, clean modern vector style with soft shading and subtle paper grain, limited palette of deep navy blue (#0B3D7A), bright sky blue (#0094D9), warm light grey and white, with small accents of warm orange (#E07A2E). Calm, professional, friendly. Horizontal 16:9 composition with generous empty space on the left third. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO signs with writing anywhere in the image.

kartinki.poteri-1945: Post-war Japan around 1950: a modest, sparse car assembly workshop with a wooden floor, a few determined workers in caps assembling a truck chassis mostly by hand, very few machines, a feeling of scarcity and determination, soft morning light through dusty windows.
kartinki.ono-krug: Factory floor of a 1950s Japanese car plant: a young engineer in work clothes stands inside a white chalk circle drawn on the concrete floor, holding a small notebook, carefully observing a moving assembly line; an older experienced mentor in glasses watches him from a distance with arms crossed.
kartinki.tsennost: Concept of a supply chain flow seen from above: a single parcel travels along a long winding path from a supplier warehouse to a customer; almost the whole path is grey (queues, storage shelves, waiting trucks, piles of documents) and only one tiny short segment glows bright sky blue where real useful work happens.
kartinki.shturmovshchina: Soviet factory in the 1970s at the end of the month: workers rushing frantically and carrying parts to finish production on time, overtime under bright lamps, a big tear-off wall calendar with only its last pages left (no visible numbers); in the faded background, the same workshop earlier in the month with idle workers sitting and waiting for parts.
kartinki.kantorovich: Stylised map of a vast northern country with railway lines; two freight trains loaded with the same stacked timber travel towards each other on parallel tracks in opposite directions, illustrating wasteful cross transportation; in the corner a 1940s mathematician's desk with a slide rule, an abacus and sheets with abstract diagram lines (no readable writing).
kartinki.gastev: 1920s Soviet Central Institute of Labour training workshop: rows of young workers in work shirts at identical workbenches practicing precise hammer strikes on chisels under the eye of an instructor with a stopwatch, every tool hanging in its own fixed place on a board, bright constructivist geometric atmosphere.
kartinki.zapasy: Overstocked supply warehouse: tall racks overflowing with boxes, pipe bundles, valves and spare parts covered in dust, narrow aisles blocked by pallets, a small forklift squeezed between piles; in the foreground a stack of coins frozen inside a block of ice as a metaphor for frozen money.
kartinki.zasedanie: Satirical 1920s Soviet office scene inspired by the idea of endless meetings: officials in suits sitting around a long table covered with tall stacks of papers, rubber stamps and ink, a big wall clock, cigarette smoke; a tired visitor with a single document waits at the door for hours.
kartinki.brak: Soviet 1960s quality control scene: a focused inspector in a white coat checks a machined steel part with a caliper at a clean factory workbench; on one side a tray of rejected parts with red marks, on the other a neat tray of accepted parts; a worker proudly hands over his part to be accepted on the first try.
kartinki.briz: Soviet factory worker in overalls proudly explains a simple clever improvement to a fixture on his machine to engineers and a foreman who listen with interest; a glowing light bulb shape above his head; a suggestion box hangs on the wall (no writing).
kartinki.mtr: Cargo transshipment at a remote Siberian supply base in winter: a crane unloads wooden crates and bundles of steel pipes from a truck onto a river barge, snow and frosty air, one wooden crate is visibly cracked and damaged at the moment of handling, a worker points at it.
kartinki.ohota: Concept of hunting for waste: a magnifying glass held over a simple process diagram of a warehouse (trucks, shelves, forklifts, office desk), revealing small hidden orange warning markers at several spots of the process.
kartinki.slonenok: Storybook illustration of a curious baby elephant with a short nose asking endless questions to a giraffe, a hippo and an ostrich in an African savanna, warm and humorous, inspired by Kipling's Elephant's Child.
kartinki.ryba: A team of office colleagues standing at a whiteboard with a big fish skeleton diagram drawn as arrows, colourful sticky notes attached to the bones, one person adding a note, the fish head at the right side.
kartinki.shturm: Energetic office brainstorming session: diverse colleagues of different ages put many colourful sticky notes on a glass wall, nobody criticises, people smiling, a young employee speaks while a senior manager listens.
kartinki.matrica: A hand placing a sticky note onto a whiteboard divided into four equal quadrants by two bold arrows, each quadrant already holding a few notes of different colours.
kartinki.a3: A single large sheet of paper on a wooden desk with a neatly structured problem solving report layout: boxes, a small bar chart, a fishbone sketch and a timeline (all without readable writing), a pen and a cup of coffee next to it.
